name: Alters Baseline Reality
description: You have the dangerous ability to manipulate the fabric of reality itself.
connectionOptions: One PC witnessed you accidentally alter reality in a disturbing way.
You once used your powers to help one PC, but at a great cost.
One PC is studying your abilities to better understand reality alterations.
additionalEquipment: Schrödinger's notebook (never sure what's written inside)

abilities.name: Reality Glimpse
abilities.description: You can see glimpses of alternate realities, giving you an asset to initiative rolls.

abilities.name: Minor Alteration
abilities.description: You can make a minor, temporary change to physical reality within immediate range.

abilities.name: Probability Shift
abilities.description: You can subtly alter probabilities, allowing you to reroll any roll once per day.

abilities.name: Localized Paradox
abilities.description: You can create a localized paradox, hindering all actions of a target within short range for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Reality Pocket
abilities.description: You can create a small pocket of altered reality that lasts for 10 minutes, within which you define minor laws of physics.

abilities.name: Quantum Superposition
abilities.description: You can exist in a state of superposition for 1 round, allowing you to take two actions simultaneously.

abilities.name: Rewrite the Rules
abilities.description: Once per session, you can temporarily rewrite a fundamental law of reality within long range for 1 minute.
